title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.39570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. translated_title: 基于LLM智能体的RISC-V CPU设计及FPGA在环评估方法
translated_abstract: CPU候选设计的长时间RTL仿真可能需要数小时，而短时间的诊断运行可能会遗漏在执行后期才显现的性能退化问题。这种评估成本会延误基于LLM智能体的CPU开发中的设计决策。我们提出了一个开发环境，其中LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计，并利用板载性能测量来指导设计决策。我们将其应用于在人工监督下将单周期RV32I核心开发为三发射乱序RV32IM核心的过程。最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上以130 MHz的频率达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz的性能。对于运行8,000次CoreMark迭代的同一CPU候选设计，包含实现流程在内的FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍。在一个案例中，板载测量揭示了某个候选设计虽在短时间诊断运行中表现提升，但存在长时间运行性能退化的问题。这一结果指导了候选设计的选择，并促成了基于RTL的根因分析。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个让LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计并利用板载性能测量指导设计决策的开发环境，评估速度比RTL仿真快9.6倍，成功将单周期RV32I核心开发为达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz的三发射乱序RV32IM核心。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a development environment where LLM agents implement CPU candidates on FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions, achieving 9.6x faster evaluation than RTL simulation and successfully evolving a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core reaching 5.61 CoreMark/MHz.
